pr.title: feat(gitea): sweep involved PRs to catch self-merges and own-PR activity
pr.body: Closes #92. Gitea involved-PR sweep. The Gitea source was notifications-only, so it had the same gaps GitHub (#86, #38) and GitLab already handle: a merge/close you do yourself (Gitea doesn't notify you) and activity on your own PRs were invisible. ### Change Adds `gitea.track_prs` (default true, matching GitHub) and an involved-PR sweep via `/repos/issues/search` (`created`/`assigned`/`mentioned`/`review_requested` scope the results to you). Mirrors the GitHub architecture: an open sweep plus a recently-closed sweep (`state=closed&since=`, skipped on the first poll so it baselines forward), a shared `process_pr` + `diff_swept_prs`, and deferred snapshots for exactly-once. The per-poll INFO summary now includes `open_prs`/`closed_prs`. ### Tests `self_merged_pr_caught_by_the_closed_sweep`: open search empty, closed search returns the merged PR (matched by the `state` query param), navi fires `Merged`. Existing notification test unaffected (`track_prs: false`). Note: the `/repos/issues/search` params follow Gitea's documented issue-search API; validated here against the mock and by the hermetic Gitea e2e slice. - 🟣 ~~[feat(discord): group a PR's events into a reply chain in bot mode (#97)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/97)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(source): honor general.backfill on gitlab and gitea too (#96)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/96)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(gitea): sweep involved PRs to catch self-merges and own-PR activity (#95)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/95)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[fix(gitlab): honor general.comment_min_age_secs when diffing MR notes (#94)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/94)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(github): log a per-poll summary of what each poll examined (#89)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/89)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(github): catch self-merges/closes via a recently-closed PR sweep (#88)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/88)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: Gitea ANDs the created/assigned/mentioned/review_requested search flags, so the involved-PR sweep matches almost nothing.
